description: This script detects Continuous Integration (CI) environments and redirects to a static build server to prevent dev-server termination in CI. Otherwise, it starts the development server with specific memory configurations, handling local development scenarios.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Checks if the current environment is a CI environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously with specified arguments and environment, then exits with the command's status.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main self-invoking function that determines whether to run in CI mode or local development, setting environment variables accordingly, and launching the appropriate npm script.
